info.name: Matomo Reporting API for plugin Dashboard API
info.description: The Dashboard API lets you manage user dashboards and retrieve their widget configurations.

query.description: Response format. Defaults to `xml`. Use `original` to get the original PHP data structure.
Login of the user to load dashboards for. Defaults to the current user.
Whether to return the default dashboard when the user has none.

request.description: Returns the dashboards available to a user, including the widgets in each dashboard.

response.name:
List of dashboards, each containing name, id, and widgets keys.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.
